annotations.title: Exchange rate forecast against PLN: euro, dollar, pound, franc, krone (finwire model range)

description: Use for where the euro, dollar, pound, franc or another currency may be against PLN in the next days, weeks or months, and for a range or table of the expected rate. For current and past NBP rates, use get_currency_rates. Do not present the range as a recommendation to buy or sell. finwire forecast of the NBP mid rate of a currency against PLN (Finwire FXcast) for the next NBP table, 1 week, 1, 3, 6 and 12 months: 80% and 50% ranges, the point ("no change" unless the forward rate won the 10-year backtest) and the forward rate from the central bank rate difference. Each horizon has backtest accuracy: share of forecasts with the actual rate inside the 80% range and mean error of "no change" and of the forward rate. Only horizons that passed the accuracy gate are given. 12 currencies: EUR, USD, CHF, GBP, NOK, SEK, DKK, CZK, HUF, JPY, CAD, AUD. It is a model range, not a rate quote and not investment advice. For current and past NBP rates, use get_currency_rates.

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, NOK. Default: EUR, USD, GBP, CHF and NOK.

horizon.description: One horizon; default all published horizons.
